gloss: to endure; to bear; to put up with

definitions.gloss: to endure; to bear; to put up with; to be patient
definitions.explanation: To suppress one's desires, pain, or frustration and tolerate an unpleasant or difficult situation without complaint.

examples.japanese: ⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧{我慢|がまん}して。
examples.english: Hang in there a little longer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{暑|あつ}い→暑い：00619_atsui⟧⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧、⟦エアコン→エアコン：05282_eakon⟧なし⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{我慢|がまん}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: It's hot, but I'm putting up with it without air conditioning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{欲|ほ}しい→欲しい：01107_hoshii⟧もの⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あって→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{給料日|きゅうりょうび}→給料日：27561_kyuuryoubi⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{我慢|がまん}し⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: Even if there's something I want, I have to hold back until payday.

notes:
One of the most culturally significant words in Japanese. ⟦{我慢|がまん}→我慢：00057_gaman⟧ is widely valued as a virtue in Japanese society — the ability to endure discomfort, suppress selfish desires, and persevere without complaining. Children are taught ⟦{我慢|がまん}→我慢：00057_gaman⟧ from an early age, and it appears constantly in daily life.

The noun ⟦{我慢|がまん}→我慢：00057_gaman⟧ is used in many set phrases and is more common than the verb form in some expressions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {我慢|がまん}できない: can't stand it; can't take it anymore
- ⟦{我慢|がまん}{強|づよ}い→我慢強い：07164_gamanzuyoi⟧: patient; resilient
- ⟦{我慢|がまん}→我慢：00057_gaman⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{限界|げんかい}→限界：02715_genkai⟧: the limit of one's patience
- ⟦{我慢|がまん}→我慢：00057_gaman⟧⟦{比|くら}べ→比べる：01237_kuraberu⟧: endurance contest
- ⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧{我慢|がまん}できない: I can't take it anymore

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{耐|た}える→耐える：12087_taeru⟧: to endure; to withstand — more formal, implies bearing something severe or prolonged
- ⟦{辛抱|しんぼう}する→辛抱する：22174_shinbousuru⟧: to be patient; to persevere — similar meaning but slightly more literary
- こらえる: to hold back; to suppress — emphasizes restraining an emotion or impulse in the moment
